description.value: You know the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDruidcraft]{Druidcraft} cantrip. Starting at character level 3, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFaerieFire]{Faerie Fire} with this trait, and starting at character level 5, you can also cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplEnlargeRed]{Enlarge/Reduce} with it. Once you cast either spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell this way again until you finish a Long Rest; you can also cast either of them with any spell slots of the appropriate level you have. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you select this species).
